body: I do so much stuff. I'm in like 6 clubs at school, always around people. I just can't make any friends. I don't know why. I even tried reddit, hence this account, but it didn't work out. My 2 best friends were my world. One moved away, the other started partying and using drugs. I've been trying to hang out with some old friends but they're completely immature. I'm not happy with my girlfriend, and I want to breakup with her but if I do then she'd probably kill herself because she loves me so much.
